Class Zoo

  • java.lang.Object
    • model.Zoo

  • public class Zoo
extends java.lang.Object
    Represents a Zoo with a name, city, address, budget, and a collection of habitats.

    • Constructor Detail

      • Zoo

        public Zoo(java.lang.String name,
           java.lang.String city,
           java.lang.String address,
           double budget)
        Constructs a Zoo object with the specified name, city, address, and budget. Initializes an array to store up to 33 habitats.
        Parameters:
        name - The name of the zoo.
        city - The city where the zoo is located.
        address - The address of the zoo.
        budget - The initial budget of the zoo.

    • Method Detail

      • getInformation

        public java.lang.String getInformation()
        Retrieves the general information of the zoo, including its name, city, address, and budget.
        Returns:
        A string containing the general information of the zoo in the format: "name-city-address-budget".

      • addHabitat

        public boolean addHabitat(java.lang.String code,
                          java.lang.String name,
                          int environment,
                          double area,
                          int maxCapacity)
        Adds a new habitat to the zoo. The habitat is created with the specified name, environment, and area. The habitat is added to the first available position in the habitats array. Preconditions: - The 'myHabitats' array must be initialized. Postconditions: - If there is an available position in the `myHabitats` array, the new habitat is added to the zoo.
        Parameters:
        code - The code of the habitat.
        name - The name of the habitat.
        environment - The type of environment in the habitat (e.g., jungle, desert).
        area - The area of the habitat in square meters.
        maxCapacity - The maximum capacity of the habitat.
        Returns:
        true if the habitat was successfully added; false if there is no available space in the habitats array.

      • hasAvailableHabitat

        public boolean hasAvailableHabitat()
        Checks if there is at least one available habitat in the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats` array must be initialized.
        Returns:
        true if there is at least one habitat available; false otherwise.

      • getHabitatList

        public java.lang.String getHabitatList()
        Retrieves a list of all habitats in the zoo, including their names and environments. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats` array must be initialized.
        Returns:
        A string containing the list of habitats in the format: "name-environment", with each habitat on a new line.

      • addAnimalInHabitat

        public boolean addAnimalInHabitat(java.lang.String habitatName,
                                  java.lang.String name,
                                  double weight,
                                  java.lang.String dietType,
                                  java.lang.String lifeStage,
                                  java.lang.String healthStatus)
        Adds an animal to a specific habitat in the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats` array must be initialized. * Postconditions: - If a habitat with the specified `habitatName` exists and has available space, the animal is added to the habitat.
        Parameters:
        habitatName - The name of the habitat where the animal will be added.
        name - The name of the animal.
        weight - The weight of the animal in kilograms.
        dietType - The type of diet the animal follows (e.g., herbivore, carnivore, omnivore).
        lifeStage - The life stage of the animal (e.g., juvenile, adult, senior).
        healthStatus - The health status of the animal (e.g., healthy, sick, injured).
        Returns:
        true if the animal was successfully added to the habitat; false if the habitat does not exist or is full.

      • getAllAnimalList

        public java.lang.String getAllAnimalList()
        Retrieves a list of all animals in all habitats in the zoo. Preconditions: - The `myHabitats` array must be initialized.
        Returns:
        A string containing the list of all animals in all habitats, separated by newlines.

      • calculateEnvironmentType

        public EnvironmentType calculateEnvironmentType(int environmentOption)
        Calculates the environment type based on the given environment option. Preconditions: - The `environmentOption` parameter must be a valid index (1-based) corresponding to an `EnvironmentType` value.
        Parameters:
        environmentOption - The 1-based index of the environment type (e.g., 1 for LAND, 2 for WATER).
        Returns:
        The `EnvironmentType` corresponding to the given `environmentOption`.

      • getEnvironmentTypeList

        Retrieves the map of the zoo as a string. Preconditions: - The `zooMap` object must be initialized (not null).
